name: Neck
summary: The neck muscles flex, extend, rotate and stabilize the head and cervical spine.

muscles.name: Sternocleidomastoid
muscles.summary: Flexes and rotates the head; largest muscle of the front of the neck.

muscles.name: Splenius
muscles.summary: Neck extensors that extend and rotate the head.

muscles.name: Semispinalis
muscles.summary: Deep neck extensor that extends and rotates the head and cervical spine.

muscles.name: Levator scapulae
muscles.summary: Elevates the scapula and flexes the neck laterally.

muscles.name: Longus colli & capitis
muscles.summary: Deep anterior neck flexors that bend the head and neck forward.

muscles.name: Suboccipital muscles
muscles.summary: Small muscles at the base of the skull that finely control head position.

muscles.name: Hyoid muscles
muscles.summary: Muscles attached to the hyoid bone that move the tongue and larynx.

muscles.name: Platysma
muscles.summary: Superficial neck muscle that tenses the skin of the neck and lower jaw.

muscles.name: Jaw muscles
muscles.summary: Muscles of mastication that close and move the jaw.

name: Chest
summary: The chest muscles help press the arms forward and inward.

muscles.name: Pectoralis major
muscles.summary: Fan-shaped muscle of the anterior chest; presses and adducts the arm, and rotates it medially.

muscles.name: Pectoralis minor
muscles.summary: Deep chest muscle that stabilizes and draws the scapula forward and downward.

name: Shoulders
summary: The shoulder muscles support raising and rotating the arms and stabilize the shoulder joint.

muscles.name: Deltoid
muscles.summary: Caps the shoulder; abducts the arm and assists in flexion and extension.

muscles.name: Trapezius
muscles.summary: Large superficial muscle of the upper back; moves and stabilizes the scapula.

muscles.name: Supraspinatus
muscles.summary: Rotator cuff muscle that initiates arm abduction.

muscles.name: Infraspinatus
muscles.summary: Rotator cuff muscle that externally rotates the shoulder.

muscles.name: Subscapularis
muscles.summary: Rotator cuff muscle on the front of the scapula that internally rotates the arm.

muscles.name: Teres major
muscles.summary: Assists adduction and medial rotation of the arm.

muscles.name: Teres minor
muscles.summary: Small rotator cuff muscle that externally rotates the shoulder.

name: Back
summary: The back muscles extend, rotate and stabilize the spine and pull the arms down and back.

muscles.name: Latissimus dorsi
muscles.summary: Large wing-shaped muscle that adducts, extends and internally rotates the arm.

muscles.name: Rhomboids
muscles.summary: Retract and stabilize the scapula toward the midline.

muscles.name: Erector spinae
muscles.summary: Column of deep back muscles that extend and laterally flex the spine.

muscles.name: Multifidus
muscles.summary: Deep spinal stabilizer that extends and rotates individual vertebral segments.

muscles.name: Splenius
muscles.summary: Neck and upper-back muscles that extend, rotate and laterally flex the head.

name: Biceps
summary: The biceps and related arm flexors bend the elbow and supinate the forearm.

muscles.name: Biceps brachii
muscles.summary: Two-headed muscle that flexes the elbow and supinates the forearm.

muscles.name: Coracobrachialis
muscles.summary: Assists flexion and adduction of the arm at the shoulder.

muscles.name: Brachialis
muscles.summary: Primary elbow flexor lying under the biceps.

muscles.name: Brachioradialis
muscles.summary: Forearm muscle that flexes the elbow, strongest when the forearm is mid-rotated.

name: Triceps
summary: The triceps extend the elbow and contribute to pushing movements.

muscles.name: Triceps long head
muscles.summary: The long head of the triceps brachii runs down the back of the upper arm.

muscles.name: Triceps lateral head
muscles.summary: The lateral head of the triceps brachii sits on the outer back of the upper arm.

muscles.name: Triceps medial head
muscles.summary: The medial head of the triceps brachii lies deep on the back of the upper arm.

name: Forearms
summary: The forearm muscles control the wrist, fingers and grip.

muscles.name: Wrist flexors
muscles.summary: Flex the wrist and assist grip.

muscles.name: Wrist extensors
muscles.summary: Extend the wrist and stabilize grip.

muscles.name: Finger flexors
muscles.summary: Flex the fingers and power the grip.

muscles.name: Finger extensors
muscles.summary: Extend the fingers and open the hand.

muscles.name: Pronators
muscles.summary: Pronate the forearm (palm down).

muscles.name: Supinator
muscles.summary: The supinator rotates the forearm so the palm faces up.

name: Core
summary: The core helps stabilize the spine and transfer force between limbs.

muscles.name: Rectus abdominis
muscles.summary: The 'six-pack' muscle that flexes the trunk and stabilizes the pelvis.

muscles.name: Transversus abdominis
muscles.summary: Deep corset-like muscle that compresses the abdomen and stabilizes the core.

muscles.name: Internal oblique
muscles.summary: Lateral trunk muscle that rotates and laterally flexes the spine.

muscles.name: External oblique
muscles.summary: Superficial lateral trunk muscle that rotates and bends the trunk.

muscles.name: Quadratus lumborum
muscles.summary: Deep back muscle that stabilizes the pelvis and lateral spine.

name: Quadriceps
summary: The quadriceps extend the knee and contribute to rising and jumping.

muscles.name: Rectus femoris
muscles.summary: The only quadriceps head that crosses the hip; extends the knee and flexes the hip.

muscles.name: Vastus lateralis
muscles.summary: Outer quadriceps head that extends the knee.

muscles.name: Vastus medialis
muscles.summary: Inner quadriceps head that extends the knee and stabilizes the kneecap.

muscles.name: Vastus intermedius
muscles.summary: Deep quadriceps head that extends the knee.

muscles.name: Sartorius
muscles.summary: Long strap muscle that flexes, abducts and externally rotates the hip.

name: Hamstrings
summary: The hamstrings flex the knee and extend the hip.

muscles.name: Biceps femoris
muscles.summary: Two-headed hamstring that flexes the knee and extends the hip.

muscles.name: Semitendinosus
muscles.summary: Inner hamstring that flexes the knee and extends the hip.

muscles.name: Semimembranosus
muscles.summary: Inner hamstring that flexes the knee and medially rotates the leg.

name: Glutes
summary: The gluteal muscles extend and stabilize the hip during locomotion.

muscles.name: Gluteus maximus
muscles.summary: Large hip extensor that powers rising, climbing and running.

muscles.name: Gluteus medius
muscles.summary: Abducts the hip and stabilizes the pelvis while walking.

muscles.name: Gluteus minimus
muscles.summary: Deep abductor that also internally rotates the hip.

muscles.name: Piriformis
muscles.summary: Deep hip rotator that assists abduction and stabilizes the pelvis.

name: Calves
summary: The calf muscles point the foot and stabilize the ankle for walking and jumping.

muscles.name: Gastrocnemius
muscles.summary: Superficial calf muscle that points the foot and flexes the knee.

muscles.name: Soleus
muscles.summary: Deep calf muscle that primarily powers ankle push-off.

muscles.name: Tibialis anterior
muscles.summary: Shin muscle that lifts (dorsiflexes) the foot.

muscles.name: Fibularis group
muscles.summary: Lateral lower-leg muscles that evert the foot and stabilize the ankle.

muscles.name: Plantaris
muscles.summary: Small calf muscle that assists knee flexion and ankle plantarflexion.

muscles.name: Popliteus
muscles.summary: Unlocks the knee by internally rotating the tibia.
